name: Invo
audience: freelancers and small businesses who send invoices and quotes
oneLiner: A free, private invoice, receipt and quote generator that runs in your browser.
facts: Makes six kinds of document: invoice, tax invoice, quotation, estimate, receipt and credit note.
You can add your own logo.
Your data is saved locally in your browser, on your device. It works without needing the internet.
Clearing the browser cache deletes the saved data, so export a PDF to keep a permanent copy.
dont: Do not say it sends invoices, takes payments, tracks who has paid, or syncs between devices.
angles: sending your first invoice as a freelancer
a client asks for a quote today
paying for invoicing software you barely use
keeping client data off other people's servers
the six document types and when to use each

screens.shows: The Invo home page: "Get paid faster, look professional", unlimited invoices, receipts and quotes, and the No Login Needed, PDF Export, Add Your Logo and Auto-Tax Calc labels, with a note that data is saved locally.
The six document types to pick from: Invoice, Tax Invoice, Quotation, Estimate, Receipt and Credit Note.
